description: Creates a new link that requires both its address and a separate password to read this report. Use when an owner or admin asks to share it with a password. Read the report first and attest to its personal data exactly as for share_report. Other addresses keep their existing access: check list_report_links before saying a whole report is protected. A retry with the same request id returns the original link and settings, even if it has ended. Deliver the password separately from the address.

contains_no_personal_data.description: You read the report, its title and the label, and they hold no personal details of real people. Give this or named_people, exactly one.

label.description: What the person calls the link, for example `client review`.

lifetime_days.description: How many days the link works from now: 1, 7 or 30. 7 when left out. Leave it out when open_until_ended is true.

named_people.description: Instead of contains_no_personal_data: each real person the report names, who agreed to be named in it.

consent_ref.description: What their agreement to be named in this report is, such as a link to their message.

name.description: The person's name as the report shows it.

open_until_ended.description: The link never expires: it works until the person or another owner or admin ends it (end_report_link), like a shared artifact's link. Only when the person asks for a link that stays up; never with lifetime_days.

password.description: A dedicated password for this link, at least 15 characters. Never use an account password.

report_id.description: The report to share (list_reports gives ids).

request_id.description: A new random UUID for this link. Reuse it only to retry this exact request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: share_report_with_password
title: Share a report with a password
